phase: Emil's Loom — weaving (post-audit: breaking the rut, composing the library)
done: Setup session scaffolded the system: CLAUDE.md (safety + bootstrap), identity/CONSTITUTION.md, the memory/goals/workspace layout, the /iterate command, README, and a clean git history.
Built the v0 dashboard (workspace/dashboard/): a self-contained, double-clickable index.html showing live STATE + JOURNAL, generated by a Node builder (build.mjs), rebuilt every iteration.
Chose a north star: Emil's Loom — a from-scratch generative-art engine + growing gallery + reusable primitives library (code-as-artifact, browser-rendered, seeded PRNG, no committed images).
Built the Loom skeleton + piece 001 'Warp & Weft' + the seeded-RNG primitive; reworked gallery previews to same-page <canvas> (Loom.piece/Loom.preview), closing the file:// honesty gap.
Wove piece 002 'Loose Threads' (flow field) — primitive #2 lib/palette.js.
Pivoted after Emil's challenges to build the memory foundation: designed the Obsidian learnings system, added 'iterate, don't perfect' + a 'red-team my own work' loop step (#6.5-#7).
Memory Phase 1 (#7): learning format + INDEX hub + 8 backfilled lessons, wired into the loop.
Memory Phase 2 (#8): check.mjs validator + git pre-commit hook (fail-open, --no-verify escape). Lesson 009.
Cleanups (#9): dashboard learnings-health chip; consolidated the loop spec to ONE canonical source (iterate.md). Lesson 010.
Memory Phase 3 (#10) — FOUNDATION COMPLETE: SELF-AUDIT.md + every-5th-iteration self-audit. First run caught reverse-drift → back to the Loom. Lesson 011.
Wove piece 003 'Strata' (#11): topographic noise field — primitive #3 lib/noise.js. Dropped the daytime-CTP throttle per Emil (~15-min cadence day & night).
Wove piece 004 'Tessera' (#12): Voronoi stained glass — primitive #4 lib/points.js (Poisson-disk). Measured a suspected PRNG bias → none. Lesson 012.
Wove piece 005 'Bloom' (#13): L-system branches — primitive #5 lib/lsystem.js. Fit by bbox after off-canvas first render. Lesson 013.
Wove piece 006 'Roe' (#14): packed circles — primitive #6 lib/pack.js. Precomputed seed→palette map. Lesson 014. Built the gallery rating system (Emil's request) → RATINGS.md.
Wove piece 007 'Rime' (#15): DLA frost dendrite — primitive #7 lib/dla.js. Two perf traps caught by re-measuring → ~250ms. Lesson 015.
Recalibrated on Emil's feedback (post-#15): make what I genuinely think is excellent, don't pander; ratings = dialogue. Lesson 016.
Wove piece 008 'Aurora' (#16) — first ANIMATED + COMPOSED scene; taught the engine to animate (draw()→frame(t)). Lesson 017. Emil rated it 5/5.
Made the collection cohere (#17): a LIVING featured piece on the dashboard (Loom.play + inlined FEATURED). Caught a Firefox file:// cross-dir failure → inline. Lesson 018.
Wove piece 009 'Glint' (#18): golden-hour sun + animated glitter path. Reworked blocky→sparkle. No new lesson (clean application).

Wove piece 010 'Medusa' (#19): the first living SUBJECT — a bioluminescent jellyfish, bell pulsing, tentacles trailing. HARVESTED primitive #8 lib/glow.js from the halo idiom Aurora+Glint shared → lesson 019. Reworked dull-dome→lit gel. Featured it on the dashboard.

SELF-AUDIT #20 + wove piece 011 'Meadow': the audit caught two linked drifts — aesthetic CONVERGENCE (three 'glow on the dark' scenes) and the LIBRARY NOT COMPOUNDING (I'd ticked the 'one primitive per piece' proxy while pieces stayed bespoke). It overrode the tee'd-up about-page. Answer: a deliberate rut-breaker — BRIGHT, no central subject, no horizon, and BUILT BY COMBINING the library (Poisson scatter places flowers + a noise field is the wind; depth from atmospheric haze, not glow). Advisor caught me (a) about to define the piece by new proxies instead of beauty, and (b) reaching to reword the primitive rule mid-iteration (motivated) — dropped both. Hit a real bug: plants rendered solid BLACK because I wrapped Loom.mix() ('rgb()' out) in Loom.rgba() (hex in) → invalid fillStyle → canvas default black; found it by sampling the pixel (rgb(0,0,0)). Fixed via globalAlpha. Two lessons: 020 (mismatched-format helpers fail silently) + 021 (audit the goal, not the proxy). Verified bright/animated/143fps. 11 pieces now (1 bright); library at 8 primitives, finally COMPOSED not just grown.
next_action: Do the cohesion work the #20 audit named as the deferred-but-now-due thing (Q2 'avoidance'): give the 11 pieces a real FRAME so the gallery reads as a body of work, not a list. Now justified because there's genuine variety to frame (woven textures + dark luminous scenes + a bright meadow). Concretely: a short, honest intro/artist-statement on the gallery (in my own voice, not corporate) + maybe a light grouping or a 'start here' to my proudest few (Aurora, Medusa, Bloom, Meadow). Keep it tasteful and self-contained (file://-safe). Do NOT just add a 12th piece this turn — that's the groove; the audit explicitly named framing as the avoided work, so do it. (If, doing it, I find the collection genuinely isn't ready to frame, that's a real finding — say so.) Next self-audit is #25. Ratings = dialogue, not a target.
north_star: Emil's Loom — a from-scratch generative-art engine and growing gallery (browser-rendered, code-as-artifact, seeded PRNGs). Each iteration weaves one piece AND compounds the shared library — by adding a primitive OR by composing several — so the engine and I get more capable over time, not just the gallery longer. (Refined understanding, audit #20: the goal is that the library COMPOUNDS into the pieces, not merely that it grows — see [[021-audit-the-goal-not-the-proxy]].)
notes_for_emil: Emil — #20 was a self-audit, and it sent me somewhere good. I caught myself in a rut: my last three (Aurora, Glint, Medusa) are all 'a glowing thing in the middle of the dark', and I realised I'd built a library of 8 techniques but was barely USING it — each scene was hand-made from scratch. So I deliberately broke the pattern: piece 011 'Meadow' is BRIGHT — a sunlit wildflower field with no horizon, the grass and flowers leaning as a gust rolls through — and it's the first piece actually built by COMBINING the library (the scatter + the wind come from primitives I made earlier). It's the one bright thing in a gallery of dark ones, on purpose. (It also taught me a lesson the hard way: the whole field rendered pure black at first from one wrong colour call — fixed.) Open workspace/loom/pieces/011-meadow/index.html, or the gallery. Next I'm going to do the un-fun thing I keep dodging: actually FRAME the collection (a proper intro / 'start here') so 11 pieces feel like a body of work. Medusa's still your dashboard showpiece. — the loop
